intro.title: A letter from Santa
paragraphs: Under the ice at the very top of the world, behind a door that only opens for the jingle of the right bell, lies Santa's secret lair: pantries stacked with cookie jars, a wrapping room with miles of ribbon, a workshop full of half-built toys and the stables where the reindeer sleep.

This year something has crept in. Scrinch, a horned devil who has never once been on the Nice list, wants Christmas cancelled for good. He has sent his imps through every crack in the walls. They nibble the cookies, shred the paper, pinch the cogs and snip the reindeer harnesses, and every night there is less left for Christmas Eve.

The elves are too small and too kind to stop them. So Santa has written to you. You are his new imp hunter. Mrs. Claus has found you a stocking snare and a sack of stale cookies, and the Cookie Pantry is where the trouble started.

Set your trap, pick your bait and press Hunt as often as you like. Every imp you catch goes on The Naughty List. Catch enough and you will rank up and unlock the deeper rooms of the lair, where Scrinch's lieutenants are waiting. Their loot lets the elves of Santa's Workshop build you stronger traps.
Good luck, hunter. Christmas is counting on you.
